highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and modernized package documentation.
highlights_body: It ships compiler XML documentation with packages and refreshes HarfBuzzSharp from the bundled native source. Review the HarfBuzz compatibility changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class enum member renamed
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now CCC132 to match the corrected upstream name; update source code that references the old member.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available
breaking.body: The aggregate enum mask was removed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m154 and includes upstream m154 fixes for buffer uploads, failed flushes, and general rendering behavior.
NuGet packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation, with API remarks maintained alongside the C# source for a more accurate consumer experience.
SkiaSharp no longer attempts to decode RAW and DNG images. Applications that accept these formats should use a dedicated decoder before creating SkiaSharp images.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzz native build warning configuration

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 added the m154 servicing fixes, package XML documentation, and the HarfBuzzSharp binding refresh.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 prepared the m154 line for validation and disabled RAW and DNG image decoding.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp now generates bindings from the native source pinned by Skia and updates to HarfBuzz 14.2.1. It also corrects the combining-class enum name and removes aggregate flag masks that are not independent options.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update.

v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 2 refreshes package documentation and the bundled renderer.
v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.body: It also updates HarfBuzzSharp to track the bundled native source.

v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the m154 line for final validation.
v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.body: RAW and DNG image decoding are no longer enabled in this release candidate.
